article.headline: Tait-Jones has 24 in UC San Diego's 90-51 win against Cal State Fullerton
article.description: — Aniwaniwa Tait-Jones had 24 points in UC San Diego's 90-51 win against Cal State Fullerton on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Tait-Jones has 24 in UC San Diego's 90-51 win against Cal State Fullerton
article.story: FULLERTON, Calif. -- — Aniwaniwa Tait-Jones had 24 points in UC San Diego's 90-51 win against Cal State Fullerton on Saturday night. Tait-Jones had five rebounds for the Tritons (13-2, 3-0 Big West Conference). Tyler McGhie scored 23 points and added five rebounds. Hayden Gray went 3 of 9 from the field (1 for 4 from 3-point range) to finish with nine points. The Tritons extended their winning streak to 11 games. The Titans (5-11, 0-4) were led in scoring by Antwan Robinson, who finished with 12 points. Cal State Fullerton also got nine points from Zion Richardson. John Square Jr. had six points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
